title: TaskPublished CDC propagation when Item's 4th review step (order=4) is approved via review.advance

setup.description: Ensure a valid tenant exists and tenantId is available for use in all requests.

Ensure a Task exists in the publisher (awp-app-plane / create service) with at least one Item, a valid taskType, duration, title, and a populated items[] array (each item carrying itemId, itemType, sectionIndex, itemIndex, scoringRule, and MCQ keys/answerOptions).
Ensure the Task's review workflow has review steps order=1, order=2, and order=3 already in an Approved/Ready state, leaving the 4th review step (order=4) as the final pending step.
Confirm the create-evb EventBridge bus is reachable and a consumer (get-ready service) is subscribed to events with source=bawp.create and detail-type=TaskPublished.
Record the taskId and all item metadata (itemId, itemType, sectionIndex, itemIndex, scoringRule, keys, answerOptions) for later assertion.

trigger.payloadShape: Object containing taskId (string, required), tenantId (string, required), and review step advancement data targeting the 4th review step (order=4) with an Approved/Ready decision.

propagation.waitFor: TaskPublished event delivered to create-evb EventBridge bus (source=bawp.create, detail-type=TaskPublished) and consumed by the get-ready service.

assertions.assertion: The review.advance call for the 4th review step (order=4) returns a success response (HTTP 2xx), confirming the step transitioned to Approved/Ready.
A TaskPublished event is emitted to the create-evb EventBridge bus with source exactly equal to 'bawp.create' and detail-type exactly equal to 'TaskPublished'.
The TaskPublished event detail contains all required fields: schemaVersion, eventId, tenantId, taskId, title, taskType, itemCount, items[], publishedAt, and publishedBy — all non-null and non-empty.
The taskId in the event payload matches the taskId of the Task whose 4th review step was just approved.
The tenantId in the event payload matches the tenantId used in the review.advance request.
The itemCount field equals the actual number of entries in the items[] array in the event payload.
Each entry in items[] contains itemId, itemType, sectionIndex, itemIndex, and scoringRule fields; MCQ-typed items additionally carry non-empty keys and answerOptions fields.
publishedAt is a valid ISO 8601 timestamp string representing the approximate time of the review.advance action.
If standards were associated with the Task, the standards array in the event is non-empty and matches the Task's configured standards; otherwise the standards field is an empty array or omitted.
If duration was set on the Task, the duration integer field in the event matches the Task's configured duration value.
After CDC propagation, calling GET /api/grdy/assignments/getTasks on the get-ready service returns a response that includes the newly published Task, identifiable by the matching taskId.
The Task record visible in get-ready contains title, taskType, itemCount, and taskId values that are consistent with those in the published TaskPublished event payload.
The items[] data visible for the Task in get-ready reflects the serialised items from the TaskPublished event, with each item retaining its itemId, itemType, sectionIndex, itemIndex, and scoringRule.
